stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
Let $f : Z \to X$ be a finite morphism of schemes which is
locally of finite presentation. Then
$f_{\proetale, *} : \textit{Ab}(Z_\proetale) \to \textit{Ab}(X_\proetale)$
is exact.
hypotheses:
Let $f : Z \to X$ be a finite morphism of schemes which is
locally of finite presentation.

reason: Étale-locally reduce the finite finitely presented f:Z→X to finite A→B. Evaluate f_* on an affine w-contractible pro-étale cover Spec D of X: the fibre Spec(D⊗_A B) is w-contractible by the finite-presentation permanence lemma, so evaluation of sheaves is exact, establishing stalkwise exactness.
